question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**although**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**although**'.
 
• **Although**, **even though**, **in spite of **and **despite** are all used to link two contrasting ideas or show that one fact makes the other fact surprising.
 
• They can all be used at the beginning or in the middle of the sentence.
 
 
• *Example: **Although** I disliked the detective heartily, I nevertheless was secretly impressed.*
 
 
 
• In spite of Darjeeling's low temperature, the author was having a great time there.
 
• Hence, '**although**' is correct in the given context.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *"We are having a great time in Darjeeling although the temperature...:*
